summary: Add a typed SQL database binding with checked-in migrations and isolated local tests before provisioning production.
description: Add Drizzle access to a typed Cloudflare D1 binding, checked-in SQL migrations and isolated database tests. Development and verify use local D1 without a cloud account, and the health route proves a real query through the framework. Production provisioning and reviewed remote migrations are separate steps. This is a storage foundation; it does not add a product data model or authentication.
seoDescription: Cloudflare D1 with Drizzle, typed Worker bindings, checked-in SQL migrations and isolated local database tests without a cloud account.
